quotes.text: ⚠️ The 3-Week Rule: Space is tight in NYC! We store fired pieces for exactly 14 days after they come out of the kiln. This means you have a total window of 3 weeks from your original class date to pick up your art. After 3 weeks, abandoned pieces are cleared out to make room for new creators.
